{{Quote|Hi there, shipmate. I'm Lin-D, an entertainment droid programmed for perpetual fun and happiness!|Lin-D, to C-3PO|<ref name="ATRS" />}}
'''Lin-D''' was a [[Gender/Legends|masculine]]-[[Programmer/Legends|programmed]] [[Entertainment droid/Legends|entertainment droid]] designed to tell jokes and make wisecracks. With a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] design, and [[Color/Legends|gray]], silver, and orange plating, Lin-D's facial features sported a perpetual grin and a pair of adjustable, white [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]]&mdash;both qualities that underscored his flippant attitude and penchant for making light of any situation. Indeed, Lin-D's loquaciousness proved unbearable to some; the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] found him to be quite annoying.

Lin-D met C-3PO and his companions, the [[Human/Legends|Humans]] [[Mungo Baobab]] and [[Auren Yomm Baobab|Auren Yomm]], in [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]] after being forced to join a team of [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] rowers on the large [[Boat/Legends|galley]] ''[[Roon Clipper]]'', which was operated by agents of [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Bisad Koong|Koong]] of [[Tawntoom]] Province on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Roon/Legends|Roon]]. When the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] infiltrated the galley while out on the [[Roon Sea]], Lin-D was freed with the others and fled on a [[lifeboat]]. He was incapacitated in the ensuing [[Skirmish on the Roon Sea|skirmish]] with Koong's [[Drone/Legends|drones]], but R2-D2 restored him to full working order.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I don't see there's anything to be happy about.''"<br />"''What about this lovely cruise we're getting? It's free!|C-3PO meets Lin-D on a slave galley|<ref name="ATRS" />}}
[[File:ArtooFreesLinD-AtRS.png|thumb|left|250px|R2-D2 freed Lin-D and C-3PO from forced servitude to Governor Koong.]]
Lin-D was an [[Entertainment droid/Legends|entertainment droid]] manufactured before the end of [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]]<ref name="ATRS" /><ref name="Pol">{{PolyhedronCite|170|Star Wars Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO}}</ref> and [[Programmer/Legends|programmed]] to spread amusement and good cheer. By the conclusion of that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Lin-D fell into the hands of [[Bisad Koong|Koong]], the [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] of the [[Tawntoom]] Province of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Roon/Legends|Roon]]. Koong forced the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to join a crew of organic and mechanical [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] on an [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]]-going [[Boat/Legends|galley]] called the ''[[Roon Clipper]]'', where they were forced to serve as rowers. One day, Lin-D found himself chained to a galley bench and tasked with rowing the craft across the [[Roon Sea]] to [[Koong Island]] with a cargo of valuable [[gem]]s known as [[Roonstone]]s in the hold. The entertainment droid's seatmate&mdash;to whom he was shackled at the [[Limb/Legends|ankle]] during the voyage&mdash;was another mechanical, a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] named [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] who had recently joined the slave workforce after being captured along with his master, [[Mungo Baobab]], and a friend, [[Auren Yomm Baobab|Auren Yomm]].<ref name="ATRS" />

[[File:IndecentProposal-AtRS.png|thumb|right|250px|R2-D2, Lin-D, and C-3PO journeyed together in a boat.]]
Lin-D attempted to lighten the mood by joking about the situation, but C-3PO found him annoying. With a crack of the [[Unidentified human (Roon)|enslaver's]] [[electro-whip]], Lin-D joined the other captives in their [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]]-long journey. Part of the way through the voyage, Lin-D and the other [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] were freed from their shackles by the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], a colleague of C-3PO's who had sneaked aboard the ''Clipper''. When the freed captives stole [[lifeboat]]s held on the vessel, Lin-D joined C-3PO, R2-D2, Baobab, and Yomm in a craft as they made their escape. The escapees faced a savage storm and whirlpool, and an [[Skirmish on the Roon Sea|attack]] by [[Drone/Legends|drones]] that resulted in the loss of the lifeboat's [[Engine/Legends|motor]] and sail. During the latter debacle, the sail landed on Lin-D, incapacitating him.<ref name="ATRS" />

After C-3PO and the others escaped their perils in the boat, they checked on the prone entertainment droid. They feared Lin-D irreparable and consoled R2-D2, who had taken a liking to the comic mechanical. Nevertheless, over the remainder of the trip to [[Umboo]] Province, R2-D2 restored Lin-D back to full working order. The resuscitated droid expressed his thanks and suggested that he, R2-D2, and C-3PO form a touring act, "Lin-D and His Cosmic Cutups."<ref name="ATRS" />

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|Now, I wouldn't say Jabba the Hutt is fat&hellip; but when he sits around the planet, he really sits ''around'' the planet!|Lin-D|<ref name="ATRS" />}}
[[File:IndecentProposal-AtRS.png|thumb|right|180px|Lin-D's hijinks were appreciated by some, reviled by others.]]
As a [[Class three droid/Legends|class three droid]], Lin-D was designed to interact with organic beings directly.<ref name="ATRS" /><ref name="NEGTD x">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> He was an entertainment droid, programmed to spread humor and mirth. As such, he told jokes constantly, even in the most dire of circumstances. Indeed, he claimed that dangerous circumstances were the most opportune [[Time/Legends|times]] to tell jokes since it was during such crises that levity was most needed to lighten the mood. The droid tended to laugh at his own gags; his laugh was a high-pitched, staccato sound that terminated in a snort. Although some members of Lin-D's audience found his constant quipping annoying, the droid had little sympathy for them; for instance, when C-3PO expressed irritation at the entertainment droid's shenanigans, Lin-D said he thought the [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] needed to lighten up. Lin-D was fluent in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] and was programmed with a [[Gender/Legends|masculine]] personality.<ref name="ATRS" />

Lin-D had a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] body structure, with two [[Limb/Legends|arms]], two legs, a torso, and a head. Although his neck and limbs were long and thin,<ref name="ATRS" /> standing him a bit taller than 1.7 [[Meter/Legends|meters]],<ref name="height" /> he had a pot belly. Lin-D's face was elongated, with a large [[Nose/Legends|nose]] and a long jaw centered between wide cheeks. The droid had a large, ever-grinning [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]] that could open and close. Lin-D's neck, hands, nose, and brow were gray in [[Color/Legends|color]], and his fingers, mouth, jowls, forehead, and upper arms were silver. In contrast, his forearms, elbows, torso, and legs were rich orange with light-orange piping. He sported two orange circles where a [[Human/Legends|Human's]] [[Ear/Legends|ears]] would be, and he had white [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]] with small black pupils in their centers. Lin-D could move the pupils in different directions either in tandem or separately, an effect he exploited to enhance the zaniness of his comic performances.<ref name="ATRS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lin-D appears in "[[Across the Roon Sea]]," an episode of the ''[[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO]]'' animated cartoon that was written by [[Sharman DiVono]] based on a story by [[Ben Burtt]] and directed by [[Ken Stephenson]].<ref name="ATRS" /> The episode originally aired on [[November 23]], [[1985]].<ref name="SWC">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref> An animation error has Lin-D appear in some scenes with five fingers per hand but only four fingers in others.<ref name="ATRS" />
